grade_barcode1d — SYMBOL print_quality op

• 資料種類:image2d → table

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.grade_barcode1d(image, symbologies=None, *, n_scans=10, aperture_x=0.5, angle_deg=None, expected_text=None)(要直接呼叫實作,import symgrade; symgrade.grade_barcode1d(image, symbologies=None, *, n_scans=10, aperture_x=0.5, angle_deg=None, expected_text=None);從台帳取用則 opssymbol.get("grade_barcode1d"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

回傳影像中一維符號的印刷品質等級(n_scans 條掃描線的平均)(table)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Grade a 1-D symbol in a reflectance image: read it (barcode1d.read_barcode1d) to find the bar direction and the module width X, filter the image with a circular measuring aperture of aperture_x · X diameter (default 0.5 X), take n_scans profiles evenly over 10 %..90 % of the bar height and grade each (grade_barcode_profile). symbol_grade = mean of the profile grades (0..4), letter its letter; parameters = per-parameter lists over the scans and parameter_grade_mean their mean grades; limiting = the parameters that most often set a profile's grade. With expected_text a profile that decodes to a different string is graded 0 (misread counts them) — a misread is worse than a no-read.

限界 / limits: 開口は円(画素で積分)、反射率は画像の値そのまま。走査線は画像の端まで伸ばし、各走査線で読めたシンボルの両側の静寂域 + 1 X だけを評価に使う。

空の入力は ValueError。拒否(ValueError): 2-D でない、非有限、n_scans < 1、aperture_x が [0, 2] の外。シンボルが見つからなければ barcode1d.Barcode1DError。
